purpose: Restore the previously approved Grow & Learn stability fix that was accidentally reverted in the full auth-stability build.
root_cause: Current build-3-guidance.js recreated/removes learning status pills during Learn rendering.
Current build also reintroduced a child-list MutationObserver on the Learn subtree.
The observer sees the DOM changes made by the status renderer and can trigger the renderer again, producing a self-triggering loop/freeze.
restored_approved_behavior: No child-list MutationObserver watches the Learn subtree.
Learn progress refreshes on page activation and explicit save/complete actions.
